messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 1745009999 (us-west-2) reports intermittent KMS decrypt failures for CONFIG_SECRET (error ~4%). See https://ci.redwood.ai/deploys/1745009999 :warning:

alice.dev: getting logs - `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/canary-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ef12ab34` . We rotated keys earlier today and updated the env var SERVICE_KMS_KEY=ef12ab34 in the deploy manifest.

sam.oncall: paging @rebecca-sre and @charles-cse - customer-facing 500s observed on /v1/embeddings, appears tied to canary nodes. :phone:

rebecca-sre: pulling traces. Impact currently to 2 premium workspaces (alpha-team, beta-inc), roughly 20 active sessions. Errors start ~1745009965.

support-ops: confirmed via CS: ticket #9210 from alpha-team reporting generation failures. New requests hitting stable are fine.

alice.dev: suspected cause: canary instance role missing kms:Decrypt permission for new key. Short term mitigation: flip feature flag to stop routing to canary or set ENV fallback to previous key id.

sam.oncall: which is faster? We should kill canary traffic first to stop user impact, then decide rollback vs IAM patch.

charles-cse: I'll flip the kill-switch. Running:
```
redwood feature-set --name canary-route-1745009999 --env prod --set enabled=false
```

deploy-bot: FEATURE_FLAG_UPDATED: canary-route-1745009999.enabled=false by charles-cse

rebecca-sre: routing moved off canary, visible error rate drop from 4% -> 0.1% within 30s. Monitoring.

support-ops: sent customer update: "We've routed traffic to stable and are investigating. No customer data lost; follow-up in 45 minutes."

alice.dev: thanks. I'll prepare a rollback artifact and open an IAM change for canary-role. Need infra approval to attach `kms:Decrypt` for key ef12ab34.

infra-bot: Change request CHG-9344 created for IAM permission add. Approval required from ops-sig.

sam.oncall: ops-sig pinged. Rebecca, any lingering failed requests catching up?

rebecca-sre: a handful of in-flight requests timed out and were retried; CS will handle any retries. No persisted data loss.

alice.dev: if ops-sig isn't quick, rollback is safe. Rollback command ready:
```
redwood rollout rollback --deploy 1745009999 --region us-west-2 --mode canary
```

charles-cse: initiating rollback now to be safe.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for 1745009999 by charles-cse

rebecca-sre: rollback complete. Service errors returned to baseline (<0.2%). Keeping monitoring window open 15m.

sam.oncall: handing off to night oncall @maya-oncall for follow-up (approve CHG-9344, run postmortem). I am off in 30m.

maya-oncall: ack taking over. I'll chase ops-sig and validate predeploy guards are implemented.

alice.dev: action items: 1) add predeploy validation that referenced KMS key IDs are permitted by canary roles, 2) add docs for feature-flag kill-switch procedures, 3) automate canary env fallback to previous key if decrypt fails. I'll file tickets and link to the postmortem.

rebecca-sre: severity lowered, customer comms updated. Root cause: key rotation without updating canary IAM permissions. Mitigated by disabling canary and rolling back. Postmortem owners: alice.dev + infra. :white_check_mark:
